response.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), with_excess AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, average_fee_rate - AVG(average_fee_rate) OVER () AS excess FROM pair_averages), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS scope_rank FROM with_excess WHERE excess > 0) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, scope_rank FROM ranked WHERE scope_rank <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, scope_rank, orderslink

assumptions.assumption: Tied pairs share a rank, so a scope may return more than three pairs.

alternatives.interpretation: Return exactly three pairs per scope when at least three qualify, breaking ties by orderslink.
